description: Explicitly synthetic opaque storage witnesses. Member bytes are marker_utf8 followed by body_hex. They are not DAG-ML documents, not Methods models and must never be executed. Unicode, NUL, BOM/CRLF, non-UTF-8 and all-256-byte contents exist only in payload bytes; manifest ids and paths stay ASCII. Semantic fingerprints of DAG-ML members are sha256(semantic_fingerprint_prefix_utf8 + path), opaque to Core; the N4MM semantic fingerprint is its raw SHA-256.
marker_utf8: SYNTHETIC ARCHIVE V3 STORAGE FIXTURE; NOT A DAG-ML DOCUMENT OR METHODS MODEL; NEVER EXECUTE
